title: demoStaff: an entry cannot name its line manager, so a fresh demo's manager approval rung has nobody until someone sets it by hand
body:
Filing gate: ③ platform gap (follow-up to #25777), measured on @objectstack 18.2.0 (hotclm PR #171).

**What is missing.** `demoStaff` (#25777, f00e8d5) creates the demo accounts an app declares, assigns their positions and runs before the seed. That works: hotclm declares 11 accounts, and a fresh `pnpm demo` needs no operator step for them. An entry carries `name`, `email`, `position?` and `permissionSets?` only, and it cannot say who the account's **line manager** is. Measured: `manager_id` is NULL on all 11 accounts after `pnpm demo`.

**Why it matters.** hotclm's approval ladder (and any app with a `type: 'manager'` approver) starts at the requester's manager. On a fresh demo, rung 1 has nobody, so the demo's approval path stalls or falls to the organization admins until someone runs Setup → Users → Set Manager, or `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/set-user-manager`, by hand. Only the platform can write `manager_id` (an admin operation), so an app cannot declare it today. The ruling that produced #25777 ("`pnpm demo` needs no operator step") is one step short.

**Expected.** An optional `manager` on a `demoStaff` entry, naming another entry by `name` or `email` and resolved after all entries exist, idempotently like the rest. `validate` refuses a `manager` that names no entry.

**Consumer.** objectstack-ai/hotclm #28 (closed by PR #171; README keeps the manual Set Manager step for this alone). HotCRM's demo has the same need for its sales managers.

**Duplicate search.** objectstack issues, all states: "demoStaff manager", "demo accounts line manager", "demo staff manager_id". The only match is #25777 (closed, this card's parent).
